entries.reason: the release does not carry it at all: read from 6.1.3's own MediaPlayer with tools/mach32_methods.py, the getter playbackStoreID is in none of the 236 classes' own instance lists and in none of the 41 categories - not on MPMediaItem (75 own methods), not on MPMediaEntity (18), not on MPConcreteMediaItem (29). The accessors it is a convenience over are present: valueForProperty: is an own method of MPMediaEntity at 6.1.3.
entries.effect: a port-created item answers playbackStoreID from its own property dictionary under the key 'playbackStoreID'; a real item is answered by the release, whose concrete class implements nothing here, and a subclass's own method always wins over a category on its public ancestor
entries.key_note: the key is the property's own name, the documented convention for MPMediaItem's property constants; not verified against a populated item, because neither this Mac nor 6.1.3 can be given one without a media library. A port-created item - one built from a dictionary, which is what the stand-in in the contract check is - is the only thing that can answer these here.
